description: HOLE-PATTERN RULE GOLDEN (ASM-A3-PATTERN review): a hole pattern counts only REAL holes, over the whole level of the seed hole. Driver R is an 80 x 50 x 10 plate with r5 corner rounds, r5 through holes at (40, 25) and (60, 25), and an r5 boss at (20, 25) standing 10 above its top face; seed S sits over R's (40, 25) hole: the corner rounds (partial arcs) and the boss rim (its wall rises out of the face) are not holes, count 2. Driver G, at (0, 100, 0), is an 80 x 50 x 10 plate with four counterbored holes (through r3, counterbore r5 from z 7 to 10, so each floor is its own annular face) at (15|65, 15|35) and an annular groove r2..r5, z 7..10, around an r2 island at (40, 25). Seed S2's pattern is seeded on the first counterbore FLOOR rim (r3, z 7): every floor of that level counts, 4. Seed S3's is seeded on the first counterbore TOP rim (r5, z 10): the groove's outer rim has the same radius but material (the island) at its centre, so it is not a hole, 4.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED, not recorded pipeline output.

R's mass properties. The rounded outline's area is 80 x 50 - 4 (5^2 - pi 5^2 / 4) = 3900 + 25 pi. The slab (z 0..10) less two r5 holes: 10 (3900 + 25 pi) - 2 x 250 pi = 39000 - 250 pi; the boss above the face (z 10..20): 250 pi. Volume 39000 mm^3.

R's surface: top face (outline less two holes and the boss footprint) 3900 + 25 pi - 75 pi; bottom face (the boss column is solid inside the slab) 3900 + 25 pi - 50 pi; outline sides: perimeter (2 x 70 + 2 x 40 + 10 pi) x 10 = 2200 + 100 pi; hole walls 2 x 10 pi x 10 = 200 pi; boss wall 10 pi x 10 = 100 pi; boss top 25 pi. Total 10000 + 350 pi = 11099.557428756427 mm^2.

R's topology: faces = top, bottom, 4 flat sides, 4 corner cylinders, 2 hole walls, boss wall, boss top = 14; edges = top face 4 lines + 4 arcs + 2 hole rims + the boss's base rim (11), bottom face 4 + 4 + 2 (10), 8 vertical side edges, the two hole seams, the boss top rim and the boss seam = 33; 1 shell.
The plate S (sketch-extrude-plate-2holes golden): volume 8429.203673205104, surface_area 3614.159265358979, centroid (20, 12.5, 5), AABB [0,0,0]..[40,25,10], 8 / 18 / 1.

Holes on R's top face: inner wires whose rim is a full circle and whose wall goes down into the slab: the rims at (40, 25) and (60, 25). The boss's base rim is an inner wire too, but its wall rises above the face; the corner rounds are quarter arcs of the OUTER wire. Count 2.

G's mass properties. Slab 80 x 50 x 10 = 40000; each counterbore removes r5 over z 7..10 (75 pi, centroid z 8.5) and r3 over z 0..7 (63 pi, z 3.5); the groove removes the annulus r2..r5 over z 7..10 (63 pi, z 8.5). Volume 40000 - 615 pi = 38067.92051804228. Symmetric about x 40 and y 25 (counterbores at x 15 / 65, y 15 / 35; groove at the centre). z moment 200000 - 4 (75 pi x 8.5 + 63 pi x 3.5) - 63 pi x 8.5 = 200000 - 3967.5 pi, z = 4.926345558013866.

G's surface: top 4000 - 125 pi (four r5 bores and the groove), island top 4 pi, bottom 4000 - 36 pi, sides 2600; per counterbore r3 wall 42 pi, floor 16 pi, r5 wall 30 pi (88 pi, x 4 = 352 pi); groove outer wall 30 pi, floor 21 pi, island wall 12 pi. Total 10600 + 258 pi = 11410.530904626166. Topology: faces top, bottom, 4 sides, 3 per counterbore, 4 for the groove = 22; edges 12 box, 6 per counterbore (4 circles + 2 seams), 6 for the groove = 42; 1 shell.

G's levels. z 7, facing up: the four floor annuli and the groove floor; their inner rims are r3 (x4, walls into the slab) and r2 (the island wall rises: not a hole). Seed rim r3 at (15, 15, 7): holes sorted (15,15), (15,35), (65,15), (65,35), count 4, shifts (0, 20, 0), (50, 0, 0), (50, 20, 0). z 10, facing up: the top face and the island top; r5 inner rims at the four counterbores and the groove, but G has material (the island) at the groove centre: count 4, the same shifts.
tolerance_rationale: CLOSED-FORM tolerance: every pose is a grounded seed or an exact translation, and the mass properties are exact areas of lines, arcs and circles. Measured first (2026-10-15, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): positions exact, centroid within 2.2e-14 mm, volume exact to the last digit. 1e-9 matches the other assembly goldens. Loosening it requires a reviewed justification here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.

probes.note: The copy's hole-1 bottom centre sits on R's second hole's top centre, as the seed's sits on the first
